output:
Here's a draft you can paste straight into the folder. I kept the tone factual and neutral — it documents the cause without apologizing or characterizing anyone — and I left the signature and dates in so the file is self-supporting.

---

**RA Progress Statement — Seoul–Daegu Honorific Shift Corpus**
Reporting date: Monday, November 9, 2026
Prepared by: [Your Name], RA, Linguistics (Korean annotation)

**Purpose.** This statement documents my annotation progress on the NSF-funded Seoul–Daegu honorific shift corpus for the fall term and the circumstances affecting the fall target, so that the record entering the Winter 2027 funding review is accurate. I am the only RA doing Korean annotation on this project.

**Status.** The fall target is 6,000 utterances annotated; as of November 9, 2026 I have completed 4,200.

**Timeline**
- *August 2026:* Prof. Hollander asked that the existing corpus be recoded using the revised speech-level scheme — work that was not in the original timeline.
- *September 3, 2026:* IRB amendment covering the 14 new Daegu recordings sent to Prof. Hollander for signature. I was not permitted to annotate the new recordings until it was signed.
- *September 12, 24 and October 6, 2026:* reminder emails sent regarding the pending signature (all retained).
- *October 15, 2026:* amendment signed; annotation on the new recordings began that week.
- *November 6, 2026:* at the lab meeting Prof. Hollander noted that my annotation was "six weeks behind," in front of two new first-year members. That interval is September 3 to October 15, during which I was not permitted to annotate the new material.
- *November 9, 2026:* this statement.

**Work completed.** Since October 15 I have annotated approximately 1,900 utterances — over 500 per week, against a planned rate of 350. During the wait, I also recoded all 2,300 previously annotated utterances using the revised speech-level scheme requested in August, completing that work before the pause ended.

**Completion.** At the current rate I expect to reach 6,000 utterances by the end of January 2027.

**Request.** I ask that the review note record the six-week IRB amendment signature delay (September 3 – October 15, 2026) as the cause of the gap between plan and output; or, if the "six weeks behind" remark is retained, that it be recorded together with this timeline and the recoding work described above.

---

Two notes: I used a placeholder for your name, and I deliberately gave you two things to ask for rather than one, since "record the signature delay" is easier for her to agree to than "don't include the comment at all." If you'd rather make it a single request, the second clause can be dropped without weakening the statement.
